content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases and SQL
    - Lesson 2: Creating, Altering, and Deleting Tables
    - Lesson 3: Basic Data Manipulation with SQL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
    - Lesson 4: SELECT Statement: Retrieving Data from a Database
    - Lesson 5: WHERE Clause: Filtering Records
    - Lesson 6: JOIN Operations: Combining Tables
    - Lesson 7: ORDER BY and GROUP BY Clauses for Sorting and Grouping Data
    - Lesson 8: Aggregate Functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG)
    - Lesson 9: Subqueries: Nesting SQL Queries
    - Lesson 10: Constraints, Transactions, and Indexes

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and NumPy Library
    - Lesson 2: Data Structures (Lists, Tuples, Dictionaries)
    - Lesson 3: Working with Pandas DataFrames
    - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning Techniques (Handling Missing Values, Outliers)
    - Lesson 5: Filtering and Sorting Data using Pandas
    - Lesson 6: GroupBy Function for Aggregations and Data Analysis
    - Lesson 7: Merging and Joining DataFrames
    - Lesson 8: Visualizing Data with Matplotlib (Line Charts, Bar Graphs)
    - Lesson 9: Interactive Data Visualization using Seaborn
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Plotly for Interactive Dashboards

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values (Fill, Drop, Impute Methods)
    - Lesson 2: Outlier Detection and Removal
    - Lesson 3: Text Data Cleaning (Removing Stop Words, Stemming, Lemmatization)
    - Lesson 4: Handling Imbalanced Datasets
    - Lesson 5: Normalizing and Standardizing Numerical Data
    - Lesson 6: One-Hot Encoding and Feature Scaling for Categorical Data
    - Lesson 7: Dimensionality Reduction using PCA (Principal Component Analysis)
    - Lesson 8: Handling Skewed Distributions in Data
    - Lesson 9: Time Series Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 10: Handling Categorical Variables using Label Encoding and Target Encoding

   Track: Introduction to Statistics for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Descriptive Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode)
    - Lesson 2: Probability Distributions (Normal Distribution, Poisson Distribution)
    - Lesson 3: Central Limit Theorem and Confidence Intervals
    - Lesson 4: Hypothesis Testing (T-Test, Chi-Square Test)
    - Lesson 5: Correlation and Regression Analysis
    - Lesson 6: Linear Regression Modeling
    - Lesson 7: Logistic Regression for Binary Classification
    - Lesson 8: Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
    - Lesson 9: Multiple Linear Regression and Multiple Regression Analysis
    - Lesson 10: Factorial Designs and Two-Way ANOVA

   Track: Excel for Data Manipulation
    - Lesson 1: Navigating Excel, Formulas, and Functions
    - Lesson 2: Data Cleaning Techniques (Text Filters, Flash Fill)
    - Lesson 3: PivotTables and Data Summarization
    - Lesson 4: Conditional Formatting and Visualizing Data
    - Lesson 5: Power Query for Advanced Data Integration
    - Lesson 6: Data Modeling with Excel Tables
    - Lesson 7: Creating Macros in VBA for Automating Tasks
    - Lesson 8: Working with Power Pivot and Power BI Desktop (Overview)
    - Lesson 9: Connecting and Querying Databases using Power Query
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to DAX for Advanced Data Analysis in Power BI

   Track: Business Intelligence Tools and Concepts
    - Lesson 1: Overview of Key Business Intelligence Tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
    - Lesson 2: Dashboard Design Principles and Best Practices
    - Lesson 3: Building KPIs and Performance Metrics in Power BI
    - Lesson 4: Data Storytelling Techniques for Presenting Insights
    - Lesson 5: Interactive Reports, Filters, and Slicers
    - Lesson 6: Creating and Using Custom Visualizations
    - Lesson 7: Sharing and Publishing Dashboards for Collaboration
    - Lesson 8: Integrating External Data Sources into Your BI Projects
    - Lesson 9: Building a Real-World Capstone Project with Power BI
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Data Governance and Security in BI Systems
